title: Gold Robot EA [RSI zone + Doji reversal, dynamic ATR trailing]
entry_long: RSI(7)<30 (oversold) AND previous candle is bullish doji (lower wick > upper wick, small body)
entry_short: RSI(7)>70 (overbought) AND previous candle is bearish doji (upper wick > lower wick, small body)
exit: trailing stop dynamic = TS(60 pips)+ATR-scaled buffer (TS+ATR formula), trailing step 1 pip; grid-recovery close via variable close-money formula (~5-10 USD scaling with order count); no fixed SL/TP on entries
escalation_cap: lot size capped at 0.1 (Volume Upper Limit); Max Order = 50 per side; lot increases +0.01 every 5 recovery orders
buildon_idea: already capped (max 50 orders, 0.1 lot ceiling); flat-lot test first to confirm entry edge; try linear-add lot law instead of step martingale; ATR-scaled trailing is a reusable vol-gate idea
novelty_note: RSI zone + doji reversal entry is common; ATR-adaptive trailing stop (TS+ATR formula) is a more novel reusable component

title: Single Candle Template block tutorial (candlestick property filter for entries)
entry_long: RSI(7)<30 AND candle ID1 matches template: long lower wick >=50% of candle size (either direction) OR big bullish body candle (wicks <=10% each), candle size >=100 pips
entry_short: RSI(7)>70 AND candle ID1 matches template: long upper wick >=50% of candle size OR big bearish body candle (wicks <=10% each), candle size >=100 pips
exit: close both buy+sell groups together when combined unrealized profit > $5; no SL/TP on individual entries; grid re-entry every 100 pips
escalation_cap: lot size capped at 0.1 (Volume Upper Limit); lot increases +0.01 per grid step (no explicit order-count cap stated)
buildon_idea: add explicit Max Order cap (not shown this example); flat-lot test to isolate the Single Candle Template filter's edge; the template block itself (wick%/body% filter) is a reusable, testable primitive across other EAs
novelty_note: tutorial video introducing FX DMA's Single Candle Template block; the block itself is reusable/novel infrastructure, the strategy shown is a simple demonstration

title: Multi-Group Scalping EA v1 [candlestick pattern + EMA8/18 trend filter, dual-sided close]
entry_long: candle ID1: long lower wick >=40% of candle size (any candle color) OR strong bullish body (wicks <=20% each), candle size>=100 pips; AND EMA8>EMA18 (uptrend confirm)
entry_short: candle ID1: long upper wick >=40% of candle size OR strong bearish body (wicks<=20%), candle size>=100 pips; AND EMA8<EMA18 (downtrend confirm)
exit: grid recovery adds every 100 pips (fixed distance) with lot +0.01/order; combined buy+sell profit check closes both groups together when profit > 100 pips (developer-improved safety vs EX137/138); no per-trade SL/TP
escalation_cap: lot size capped at 0.1 (Volume Upper Limit); no explicit Max Order count cap mentioned in this version
buildon_idea: add explicit Max Order cap (added later in the RV1 follow-up); flat-lot test to isolate EMA+candlestick entry edge from the grid; test on lower-volatility pairs cautiously since backtest showed poor DD on EURUSD
novelty_note: combines EMA trend filter with wick/body candle template; combined-group profit-close (vs separate close in EX137) is the key safety improvement shown

title: Multi-Group Scalping EA RV1 [dynamic grid distance doubling, capped martingale, distance-to-EMA safety filter]
entry_long: candle ID1: long lower wick >50% of candle size (candle size>=10 pips) OR strong bullish body (wicks<=10%); AND EMA10>EMA50; AND current price within 10 pips of EMA10 (avoid chasing price)
entry_short: candle ID1: long upper wick >50% OR strong bearish body (wicks<=10%), candle size>=10 pips; AND EMA10<EMA50; AND current price within 10 pips of EMA10
exit: dynamic grid: recovery distance doubles each add (10->20->40->80 pips via adjust_distance=2), lot doubles each add (lot_x=2); close both groups when profit > $5; no per-trade SL/TP
escalation_cap: Max Order = 10 per side (explicit cap added vs EX138 base); lot doubles per recovery order via lot_x=2
buildon_idea: already capped (10 orders/side); flat-lot test to confirm entry edge separate from dynamic grid; backtest result shown (+32.8% / 7.29% DD over 9mo) is a build-on candidate worth extending to more symbols/TFs; the distance-to-EMA "don't chase price" filter is a reusable safety primitive
novelty_note: dynamic (exponentially widening) grid distance + capped lot doubling + distance-to-EMA entry filter is a meaningfully improved iteration vs the earlier fixed-grid versions

title: Smart Money Recovery Engine [ICT price-pattern zone + dynamic doubling grid + equity cut-loss]
indicators: ICT price pattern (3-candle impulse zone via horizontal lines)
entry_long: 3 consecutive bearish candles (ID3,ID2,ID1) with summed body size >=100 pips draw a zone (line B1 low/B2 high); enter buy when price re-enters and closes back inside the zone (between B1 and B2)
entry_short: 3 consecutive bullish candles with summed body size >=100 pips draw a zone (S1 high/S2 low); enter sell when price re-enters and closes back inside the zone
exit: close both buy+sell when profit > $5; grid recovery distance doubles each add (100->200->400->1600 pips via adjust_distance=2); lot increases +0.01 per recovery order (capped at 0.1 lot ceiling); equity-level cut-loss at -$3000 unrealized; no per-trade SL/TP
escalation_cap: lot size capped at 0.1 (Volume Upper Limit); no explicit max-order-count cap stated; portfolio cut-loss at -$3000 acts as ultimate backstop
buildon_idea: add explicit max-order-count cap in addition to the $3000 equity cut-loss; flat-lot test to isolate the ICT zone re-entry edge from the dynamic grid; the exponentially-widening recovery distance + chart-object zone drawing technique is reusable across other pattern-based EAs
novelty_note: first use of ICT-style 3-candle impulse zone drawn as chart objects for entry timing; exponential (doubling) grid distance is more novel than fixed-step grids seen in earlier examples

title: Multi-Group Scalping EA [ICT zone + bullish/bearish engulfing entry, dynamic doubling grid]
entry_long: 3 consecutive bearish candles with summed body >=40 pips draw zone (B1/B2); enter buy when price closes back inside zone AND candle ID1 is bearish AND current close > candle ID1 open (bullish engulfing of ID1)
entry_short: 3 consecutive bullish candles with summed body >=40 pips draw zone (S1/S2); enter sell when price closes back inside zone AND candle ID1 is bullish AND current close < candle ID1 open (bearish engulfing of ID1)
exit: close both groups combined when profit > 15 pips; dynamic grid recovery distance doubles each add (15->30->60...); lot increases +0.01 per recovery order; trailing stop 20 pips/step 1 pip on winning (FTB/FTS) side; no per-trade SL/TP
escalation_cap: none stated in this transcript (no explicit lot ceiling or max-order-count constant mentioned)
buildon_idea: add explicit lot ceiling and max-order cap before live use (transcript reports backtest survived without hard cap, i.e. relies on account size); flat-lot test to isolate ICT-zone+engulfing entry edge; reported backtest +500%/33% DD over 5yr9mo on EURUSD is a strong build-on candidate to extend across symbols/TFs with a cap added
novelty_note: combines ICT zone re-entry with classic engulfing confirmation; reported long backtest (5yr9mo, +500%) is a notable claim worth independent verification

title: Multi-Group Scalping EA [Higher-TF ZigZag breakout filter + ICT zone + engulfing entry, dual-TF]
entry_long: 4H ZigZag breakout above prior swing high sets buy-mode=1 (draws Line_buy on 4H swing high, break confirms uptrend); then on entry TF: 3 consecutive bearish candles body-sum>=100 pips draw ICT zone, enter buy when price closes back inside zone AND bullish engulfing of candle ID1 occurs
entry_short: 4H ZigZag breakout below prior swing low sets sell-mode=1 (Line_sell); then 3 consecutive bullish candles draw ICT zone, enter sell when price closes back inside zone AND bearish engulfing of candle ID1 occurs
exit: close both groups combined when profit > 60 pips; dynamic grid recovery distance doubles each add (100 pips base); trailing stop 150 pips/step 1 pip on winning side; no per-trade SL/TP; author notes $10,000 capital insufficient to survive full 2024 XAUUSD run without blowing account under default params
escalation_cap: unspecified in this transcript (builds on EX139 structure; author explicitly warns account can blow up with default settings and insufficient capital)
buildon_idea: critical: add explicit lot ceiling + max-order cap before any live use — author's own disclaimer says default params can blow the account on XAUUSD; flat-lot test to isolate the 4H-breakout + engulfing entry edge from the grid; the dual-timeframe (4H trend gate + 1min entry) pattern is a reusable, high-value primitive worth extracting independent of the martingale exit
